plugin.name: wayfire-zoom-peek
plugin._long: Launchpad-style reveal: the lumen-drawer grid zooms down from above to its normal size while the frozen desktop behind it fades into a blur. The panel stays live on top.

option.name: dismiss
option._long: Optional secondary binding that only closes the reveal. Unset by default so it does not conflict with other plugins that consume Escape.

option.name: close_duration
option._long: Length and easing of the zoom back out when the drawer closes. Separate from the open animation so the two can ease differently.

option.name: initial_scale
option._long: Scale the grid starts at before it zooms back to normal size.

option.name: blur_levels
option._long: Number of halving steps in the background blur; each one roughly doubles the blur radius.

option.name: dim
option._long: Opacity of the black layer over the blurred background, so grid labels stay legible.

option.name: drawer_app_id
option._long: App-id (layer-shell namespace) of the desktop grid surface. It is kept hidden while the reveal is closed.
